- changelog.d/6449-wave-judge-read-profile.md: line 2 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The changelog states "the Codex fallback strips GitHub and Telegram tokens and uses a read-only sandbox" as if this PR introduces that hardening, but the PR diff makes no change to the Codex fallback path.
  WHY: No runtime failure. The changelog wording creates a documentation-vs-diff mismatch: a future contributor who reads the changelog to understand what changed may wrongly conclude the Codex fallback was previously unhardened or that this PR fixed it.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Have trusted code validate its JSON and perform only resource-scoped API writes with a least-privilege token." From the linked issue: "Have trusted code validate its JSON and perform only resource-scoped API writes with a least-privilege token."
  Expected change site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh::extract_judge_json_with_status` (line 307) and the failed-verdict `issues_to_revert` handler (line 23977)
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff changes neither site. The `extract_judge_json_with_status` parser at line 307 accepts any non-empty `status` string without validating the shape or membership of `issues_to_revert` entries. The failed-verdict handler at line 23977 echoes `.issues_to_revert[]` through `_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last` and creates revert PRs without checking that each target issue belongs to the active project or wave. A compromised judge (the very attack vector this issue reports) could therefore request a revert for an unrelated issue, and the trusted poller would perform that write.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- changelog.d/6449-wave-judge-read-profile.md: line 2 (full body) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The changelog describes the Codex fallback path as "strips GitHub and Telegram tokens and uses a read-only sandbox" in present tense, but the PR makes no code change to that path.
  WHY: No runtime failure, but a future reader auditing the changelog against the diff will not find a fallback-side hunk and may misread the entry as describing work done by this PR.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: From the linked issue: "Have trusted code validate its JSON and perform only resource-scoped API writes with a least-privilege token." From the PR description: "Keep GitHub writes in trusted poller code, acting on validated JSON through resource-scoped helpers." The first half of the recommendation (WAVE_JUDGE in credential-free, networkless read profile) is implemented by this PR; the second half (trusted code validates the JSON before performing API writes) is not.
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh around line 23977 (the `issues_to_revert` failed-verdict handler) and around line 307 (`extract_judge_json_with_status`).
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff does not modify scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh at all. Verified by reading the handler at line 23977: `echo "${JUDGE_JSON}" | jq -r '.issues_to_revert[]?' | while read -r revert_issue; do PR_TO_REVERT="$(_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last "${revert_issue}" 2>/dev/null || echo "")" ... gh_retry gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls" -f title="Revert PR #${PR_TO_REVERT} (orchestrator auto-recovery)" ...`. `_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last` (line 3439) returns the LAST PR that cross-references any issue number with no project/wave membership check. The parser at line 307 (extract_judge_json_with_status) accepts any JSON object with a non-empty string `status` field, with no validation of `issues_to_revert` array entries. The poller already comments "Judge JSON is untrusted" at line 23716 and adds defensive type-checking for `new_issues` (line 23720), but applies no analogous guard to `issues_to_revert` array contents. A WAVE_JUDGE running in read profile cannot make GitHub writes itself, but a child PR diff with prompt-injection content can still cause it to emit JSON that names an unrelated issue number; the trusted poller will then look up that issue's cross-referenced PR and call the GitHub API to create a revert PR against the default branch. The fix recommended by the linked issue (resource-scoped, validated JSON writes) requires the poller to verify each `revert_issue` belongs to the active project's wave before resolving its PR.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
